instruction: Cinematic medium shot of an indoor gym's boxing ring. On the left, the woman in the black and orange jumpsuit (R1) stands facing right, holding up a red focus mitt to block an incoming strike. On the right, the woman in the white sports bra (R2) faces left, extending her left arm to land a punch with her black boxing glove directly onto the mitt of the woman in the black and orange jumpsuit. The background features dark hanging punching bags under cool, dim overhead gym lighting.

R2 is the puncher, extending her left arm to strike R1's mitt with a black boxing glove
R1's mitt absorbs the contact while R2's glove delivers the strike
